{{Quote|He cut a deal with another Hutt, Gardulla. Gardulla got all slave trading, Jabba got all other illegal activities.|[[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]], about [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]|<ref name="SWG:JPEM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Ephant Mon|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Gardulla Besadii the Elder's criminal empire''' was a crime syndicate established by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Elder]] which dominated most of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis Sector]]. Like [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], Gardulla employed many [[Nikto]] guards, and other species of guards. These were mostly killed, when [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|her palace]] was attacked by [[Death Watch]]. Her empire once flourished, but interference from groups such as the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] interrupted everything, especially the slave trade enjoyed by the Besadiis. Gardulla's empire flourished once again after she allied herself with [[Komari Vosa]] of the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]], providing Besadii cargo freighters to ship neurotoxins from [[Kohlma]] to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], and in return receive from [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sebolto]] the end product of [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]] shipped to Tatooine on the same freighters for her own drug trade on the planet. She also used the freighters to ship newly inducted cult members to the burial moon. After Gardulla's apparent death, her criminal empire was taken over by her daughter [[Decca Besadii Diori]] and was based on [[C-Foroon]] and later on [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]].
